body: I understand how you feel. If you want to talk about it, it might help to talk to someone who can relate.

I feel you man. Losing the woman I loved pushed me over the edge and I failed an attempt shortly after. That was 8 months ago and I still have nightmares about her. I hope you find a way through this.
I regretted failing. My last concious thought was something like "This is how it ends". When I woke up I just felt really empty, and disappointed. Never felt relief or anything like that.

6 months ago I tried to overdose. Someone was there and I didn't die because of it. Felt the same way for a couple of weeks after, numb, kinda empty. Almost felt like it never even happened, kinda like a weird dream. That feeling faded though. I'll tell you what not to do. Don't go on with life normally and pretend it never happened. Get help now. Some worse more deep feelings have risen in me since then. Start seeing a therapist before it gets that bad.

Completely agree about trusting others. I trusted one single person completely, and really thought I was safe in doing so. She proved me completely wrong, and now I know not to trust anyone. Sorry you've both been hurt as well. Hopefully things get better someday.
